patches.operation: Modify Drosophila mass and inertial tensors -> Apis worker mass 80.0 mg with segment-level inertial rescaling
patches.rationale: Honeybee morphology differs from Drosophila and must be represented in MJCF.
patches.validation: hovering and walking CoT remain finite and within configured benchmark bands

patches.operation: Modify single dipteran wing pair plus haltere-stabilized flight assumptions -> two forewings and two hindwings, 12 wing DOF, coupled by hamuli
patches.rationale: Honeybee morphology differs from Drosophila and must be represented in MJCF.
patches.validation: forewing-hindwing phase offset remains bounded during 230 Hz stroke cycle

patches.operation: Modify generic fly tarsi and leg meshes -> hindleg corbicula pollen baskets with load-dependent actuation penalty
patches.rationale: Honeybee morphology differs from Drosophila and must be represented in MJCF.
patches.validation: loaded flight and comb traversal expose increased actuator load

patches.operation: Modify fruit-fly compound eye and antenna sensor set -> 6900 ommatidia per eye plus 170 antennal channels
patches.rationale: Honeybee morphology differs from Drosophila and must be represented in MJCF.
patches.validation: observation schema validates visual and olfactory dimensions

patches.operation: Modify fruit-fly abdomen mesh without honeybee colony effectors -> wax glands, Nasonov gland, stinger complex, and honey stomach state hooks
patches.rationale: Honeybee morphology differs from Drosophila and must be represented in MJCF.
patches.validation: BeeNiche, BeeSwarm, and BeeBody share wax, alarm, and energy signals

patches.operation: Retune wing fluid-force coefficients for coupled honeybee forewing/hindwing strokes
patches.rationale: The BeeStack spec requires figure-eight wing kinematics and hamular coupling.
patches.validation: Hovering remains stable at 230 Hz with finite CoT.

patches.operation: Expose BeeStack Observation and Action adapters around FlyBody task environments
patches.rationale: The five-module stack needs the same typed 100 Hz I/O boundary across backends.
patches.validation: validate_observation and validate_action pass for every adapter step.

patches.operation: Add apis_mellifera_worker MJCF, meshes, materials, and actuator groups
patches.rationale: BeeBody must ship a reproducible honeybee model target instead of mutating fruitfly.xml in place.
patches.validation: Fork contains bee_model_target and model-card records its source hash.

limitations: BeeBody renders through FlyBody walk_imitation/flight tasks; BeeSwarm production waggle/collision renders are strict FlyBody/MuJoCo scenes
BeeBrain, BeeMind, non-visual BeeSwarm dynamics, and BeeNiche remain reduced deterministic kernels
full flight/adhesion physics, spiking neural simulators, and BEEHAVE are extension points
raw empirical datasets are downloaded to output/data/empirical_sources and are not bundled as source
